en.title: O.J. Simpson Trial and Power Rangers Canceled Beloved Disney Cartoon
en.summary: Two unexpected forces from the 1990s converged to cut short the run of a critically acclaimed Disney animated series. The O.J. Simpson trial's extensive coverage and the explosive popularity of Power Rangers are cited as the primary culprits.
en.body:
It’s a tough pill to swallow for fans of 90s animation: a beloved, groundbreaking Disney series was cut short not by a lack of quality or audience interest, but by the confluence of a national news event and a children's television phenomenon.

According to **Gargoyles** co-creator **Greg Weisman**, the iconic animated series, which debuted in 1994, faced an early demise due to two major external factors. The most significant was the non-stop coverage of the O.J. Simpson trial. Airing on syndicated stations, **Gargoyles** found itself frequently preempted by the trial, disrupting its regular broadcast schedule and alienating viewers who couldn't rely on consistent new episodes. This constant interruption made it difficult for the show to build and maintain momentum, a critical factor for any serialized narrative, especially one aimed at a younger, yet discerning, audience.

> "The O.J. Simpson trial meant we were constantly being preempted for trial coverage, because we were on syndicated stations, and syndicated stations were more likely to preempt for that kind of coverage than network stations."

Adding to the show's woes was the immense popularity of **Mighty Morphin' Power Rangers**. While a ratings juggernaut for Fox Kids, its success meant that Disney, which also owned syndicated stations, was keen on capitalizing on similar action-oriented programming. This created a perceived need to prioritize shows with a more direct action-adventure appeal, potentially overshadowing the more complex, Shakespearean-tinged storytelling of **Gargoyles**.

## The Fan Fallout

The cancellation of **Gargoyles** remains a sore spot for many fans who have championed its return or continuation for years. The show was lauded for its mature themes, intricate plotlines, and compelling character development, setting it apart from many contemporary cartoons. The idea that such a richly crafted narrative could be derailed by news cycles and the demands of a different, albeit popular, franchise highlights the precarious nature of television production, especially in an era before streaming provided a buffer for niche or cult hits. Fans continue to debate the lost potential of the series, often pointing to the complex world-building and character arcs that were left unfinished.

## What's Next

While **Gargoyles** itself is not slated for a revival or continuation at this time, the legacy of the series lives on. **Greg Weisman** has continued to explore similar themes in his later work, and the enduring fanbase ensures that discussions about **Gargoyles** and its potential remain active in online communities. Fans hoping for new content might look to other projects from **Weisman** or keep an eye on any potential archival releases or retrospective content related to the show's history. Details regarding any future official **Gargoyles** endeavors have not yet been announced.

content_raw: If if weren't for O.J. Simpson and those meddlesome Power Rangers, one of Disney's best animated series from the 1990s might have had a longer shelf life.
